insight1_t0_discount.hypothesis: discount-driven repurchase is less sticky (expect r_deep < r_full)
insight1_t0_discount.finding: myth-busted: t0 discount depth does NOT signal churn; deep-discount repurchasers revive slightly MORE (promo-engaged regulars). Only token 0-5% discounts dip.
